report_text: Cutting operation commenced in tank farm area without clearing gas. Hydrocarbon presence confirmed by gas detector. No hot work permit was obtained before cutting started.
Line of fire incident: Worker standing in the path of a pressurised hose that was released unexpectedly. Hose whip struck the worker. No isolation was in place.
A pressure relief valve was found leaking gas near the wellhead. The isolation valve had not been closed and no permit was raised. Nearby ignition sources were present.
Fall protection not provided to workers performing elevated work at 4 metres. No harness, no safety net, no scaffold with guardrail. Workers were observed sitting on the edge.
Pre-task risk assessment completed for the day's activities. All high-risk tasks identified. Appropriate controls assigned. HSE officer signed off.
Minor hand injury reported — worker cut finger on sharp metal edge during pipe fitting. First aid administered. No lost time. Tool box meeting held after incident.
Safety officer conducted a random PPE audit. All workers in the area were found in full PPE compliance. No violations noted.
Worker was found not de-energized when working on the motor control panel. Lockout tagout not applied. Breaker was not locked before maintenance began on live circuit.
Electrical isolation verified and tagged. Work proceeded safely inside the switchroom. All steps of the LOTO procedure followed correctly. No incidents.
An H2S alarm was triggered near the separator station. All workers evacuated immediately per emergency procedure. Area isolated and gas level confirmed at 35 ppm. No injury.
Ladder was found leaning against an unstable surface. Worker climbed to 5 metres without a spotter or ties. Ladder safety training not completed.
Worker entered the pit (confined space) without attendant. Gas monitor was present but switched off. No communication link established with surface.
Worker was welding on a tank that had not been adequately purged. Internal atmosphere was not tested. An explosion occurred when ignition contacted residual gas.
A dropped object was reported from an elevated platform. A spanner fell 8 metres and landed near a worker below. No exclusion zone had been established beneath the platform.
Eye wash station found blocked by stored equipment. Station was inaccessible in an emergency. Chemical handling in the area ongoing at time of inspection.
Open flame observed near chemical drum storage. Drum contained acetone — highly flammable. No hot work permit present. Fire watch was not stationed in the area.
New safety orientation completed for all contract workers arriving on site. All workers signed acknowledgement forms. Briefing covered all site-specific hazards.
Fire watch was absent during grinding operations near an open drain. Sparks entered the drain, which contained residual hydrocarbons. Small fire resulted, quickly extinguished.
Routine water sampling conducted at site. Results sent to environmental lab. No anomalies found in this round.
Site emergency drill conducted. Muster time was within target. All personnel accounted for. First aid team responded appropriately.
Monthly safety statistics presented to management. Lost time injury frequency rate was 0. No recordable incidents this month.
Administrative staff reported a flickering light in the corridor near the control room. Facilities team notified for repair. No safety risk to operations identified.
A crane lift was in progress. Three workers were found standing below the load within the exclusion zone. No barricade had been set up around the lift area.
Worker was observed operating a drilling rig without wearing a hard hat or safety glasses. Supervisor on duty did not intervene. PPE signage was present but not enforced.
Scaffold inspection certificate was expired by 3 days. Work had continued without re-inspection. Workers found working at height on uncertified scaffold without harness.
Working at height observation: worker using damaged fall arrest equipment. Lanyard was frayed. Equipment had not been inspected and was past its service date.
During offloading of chemical drums, a forklift operator reversed without a spotter. A pedestrian was struck by the forklift. Exclusion zone was not enforced in the yard.
Chemical drum was stored incorrectly near ignition source. Drum label showed flammable content. No secondary containment present. Ignition source not cleared.
Worker observed using mobile phone while operating a vehicle inside the site perimeter. No collision occurred. Reported by site camera review.
Welding operation was being carried out in a process area. Fire watch was absent and no hot work permit had been obtained. Flammable vapours were detected nearby.
Scaffolding board was found cracked and unsecured on the second level. Work had already commenced above. No supervisor had verified scaffold integrity before work started.
Near miss — worker slipped on wet floor in the lunch room. No injury sustained. Area was mopped and wet floor sign placed.
Caught between incident — worker's arm was caught between two rotating components of a pump during maintenance. No guarding was present and equipment was still energized.
Housekeeping inspection revealed oil spill near pump station entrance. Area was not cordoned off. Workers were walking through the spill without slip-resistant footwear.
